notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and intake in progress. 233 rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), now **all five of Chapter Five's per-Grace Charm trees in full** (Heart/Nirguna 14 rows, Staff/Nirvikalpa 12 rows, Cup/Dharma 48 rows, Ring/Nirvishesha 78 rows, Sword/Nishkriya 42 rows), and the universal, non-Grace-gated Assumption-type Charm tree (shinma Nirakara, 'the Mask'; 21 Charms) that every raksha uses to take shape within Creation at all. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Still needed: the short 'Vexing'/'Questing' rules immediately preceding the Assumption tree, Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths, an apparent unreviewed sixth 'Way' Grace (Nirupadhika), and Chapter One/Two/Six/Seven's setting, Mountain Folk and Storytelling material. Locked pending the remaining inventory, schema/rules/creator/editor implementation, and passing tests across all five planned families.
